doc.hypothesis: For each of the six rules with a real edge before costs, entering with a limit order at the signal price instead of a market order nets more than zero per signal after Angel's charges and the measured cost of market exits.
doc.signals: Every signal of the six rules in the research dataset (runner.py --name y2 --live-rules --features six; code at commit f8d054b), sessions 4 Nov 2024 - 3 Nov 2026. Each signal is judged on its own; competition for slots is the forward test's question (Phase 10).
doc.limit_order: Posted at the signal price (the signal bar's close) at the signal close. Fills only if one of the next three 5-minute bars (15 minutes) trades through it by max(Rs 0.05, 1 bp of price): BUY when the bar's low <= limit - that, SELL when its high >= limit + that. Fill AT the limit, no entry slippage. Unfilled = no trade. If the fill bar also reaches the stop, the trade counts as stopped (pessimistic).
doc.after_fill: The rule's own stop and target distances from the fill (its absolute stop/target levels where the rule gives them; a target already passed = no trade), its time stop in its own timeframe counted from the fill, end of day at the closing-auction-aware square-off (CAS: open of the 15:00 5-minute bar; others: close of the 15:10 bar). Exits walk 5-minute bars: stop first when one bar reaches both; a bar opening beyond a level fills at that open. Stops, time and end-of-day exits pay the measured per-side cost (intraday_fills.slippage_bp at Rs 10 lakh, the stock's point-in-time 20-session turnover band); targets pay none.
doc.baseline: The same signals entered at market: the signal price plus the measured cost, then the identical 5-minute exit walk.
doc.charges: Angel One intraday round trip (angel_fees.round_trip) on qty = floor(Rs 10 lakh / fill).
doc.metric: Mean net bp per SIGNAL on the holdout (unfilled signals count as 0), with a t-statistic clustered by session.
doc.decision: GO for a rule: holdout mean net per signal > 0 AND clustered t >= 2 AND fill rate >= 40%. NO-GO otherwise.
doc.always_reported: fill rate; adverse selection = mean gross of filled limit trades minus mean gross of the same signals at market; the gross the market entry earned on the signals the limit missed; the development period's numbers beside the holdout's.
doc.multiple_testing: Six rules at once: a GO at t >= 2 makes a candidate for the forward test (Phase 10), not a verdict.
